editorial.evidence: Compared all 55 captured sections of the SRE case against the earlier draft section by section. The draft had silently dropped the weak/average/strong answer tiers, the five-person people map, the non-goals exception for draft timeline and approved Jira writes, the eight 'lines that carry the round', the full two-minute spoken answer, the recovery-moves figure's content, one of five weak-answer repairs, and the DENIED/INVALID confusion; all are restored. Added a numbered checkout-5xx trace to the brief, plain definitions (on-call, commander, blast radius, change freeze, dry run, MTTA, MoSCoW, fail closed), split failure handling into a walkthrough step plus a ladder dive, and recaptioned all ten source figures from their actual SVG labels (the gateway and typed-result figures are flagged as generic refund/order examples). Removed an unsupported 'model-serving CPU' claim; the 28-second upper-bound sum and the idempotency reconciliation caveat are labelled as additions. Old tab navigation is consolidated, not reproduced. Source inconsistencies resolved in text (2026-11-16): two reused pattern figures show order/refund examples inside an incident-agent case → captions no longer attribute the mismatch to the source; they state neutrally that the figure's example is generic and how the same mechanism applies here (figures are hashed originals, left unchanged).
